🚨🗣️: Gary Neville shares his thoughts ahead of the anticipated game between Manchester City and defending Champions PSG tonight. 

"Look, we’ve spent years talking about PSR and Financial Fair Play, and people keep asking: ‘Are these rules actually enforceable?’ Well, this is the moment. If you’ve got 114 proven breaches—a decade of systematically undermining the regulations—you cannot just issue a point deduction or a token fine and move on. That’s a cop-out.

UEFA has to act decisively. They need to come out and say, ‘If you cheat the system on this scale, you do not play in the Champions League. Period.’ Ban them for two, three seasons if that’s what it takes. Because if Manchester City gets off with a slap on the wrist after being found guilty of over a hundred charges, European football loses all credibility. Clubs like Arsenal, Liverpool, and Bayern Munich who operate strictly within their means are being made to look like fools. UEFA needs to set a precedent right now that no club, no matter how powerful or wealthy, is bigger than the game itself."

Half of the PS5 NoDisc NoBuy backlash was fake finds new report 

▫️ Nearly half of the replies to official PlayStation posts about the disc boycott came from fake accounts
▫️ Researchers identified 842 inauthentic accounts amplifying the backlash
▫️ Fake accounts generated over 1 million potential views and more than 113,000 engagements
▫️ Some boycott hashtags were amplified by bots in nearly 90% of cases
▫️ Genuine fans also drove significant engagement, showing the backlash was real
▫️ The online boycott appeared to have little impact on Sony’s business so far

So basically, the outrage was real, but fake accounts played a big role in it
